title: "Experimental control"

::: {.callout-note title="Where you are in your learning journey" icon=false}
**Where you come from.** You arrive here from [Causality](causality.qmd). You know why correlation is not causation and what confounders are.

**What this module adds.** You'll learn how to deal with confounding through *design*: random assignment, control groups, manipulation checks, and between- vs. within-subject designs.

**Why it is valuable.** Good design is the strongest protection against confounding: no statistical fix is as convincing as random assignment.

**Where it leads.** Next up: [ANOVA](anova.qmd).
:::
